title: "A Little Taste of Dependent Types" by David Christiansen
summary: David Christiansen gives a Strange Loop 2018 introduction to dependent types, where one language serves for both compile-time and run-time code and programs unite with proofs. It draws on his book The Little Typer.
why: Recommended as an approachable introduction to dependent types and a preview of what The Little Typer covers.

quote.text: Here's an intro to dependent types from David Christiansen
